meta.source: NWCG Standards for Unit Identifiers, PMS 931 (September 2022), section 4 'Tier 2 (Organizational Unit Agency)'
meta.terms: PMS 931: 'Publications and training materials produced by NWCG are in the public domain. Use of public domain information, including copying, is permitted. Use of NWCG information within another document is permitted if NWCG information is accurately credited to NWCG.' (no NWCG logo is used)
meta.scope: Every PMS 931 Tier 2 code, named as PMS 931 names it (USFS, FWS and FS with their department, as the equivalents below say), plus the IRWIN spellings USFS, USFWS and CAL FIRE. Codes PMS 931 does not name, or names twice with different meanings (SP: State/Highway Patrol/Police and State Parks), are shown verbatim (not_named lists the ones NIFC WFIGS was seen sending).

equivalents.USFS: PMS 931 'FS' (Forest Service) under Tier 1 'USDA' (Department of Agriculture)
equivalents.FS: PMS 931 'FS' (Forest Service) under Tier 1 'USDA' (Department of Agriculture)
equivalents.CAL FIRE: PMS 931 'CDF' (California Department of Forestry & Fire Protection)
equivalents.OES: PMS 931 lists 'OES' twice: 'Office of Emergency Services' and 'California Office of Emergency Services Fire and Rescue'; the general name is used
